title: Hackers Spend Nearly $7 Million on Expired Domains to Redirect Traffic to Scams and Malware
summary: Threat actors are acquiring expired domains to inherit website traffic and reputation to redirect victims to scams and malware on a large scale.
card_summary: Threat actors are acquiring expired domains to inherit website traffic and reputation to redirect victims to scams and malware on a large scale.
email_summary: Threat actors are acquiring expired domains to inherit website traffic and reputation to redirect victims to scams and malware on a large scale. DNS threat intelligence firm Infoblox has given the name dropcatch domains to those that get a second chance, where an expired domain becomes available for registration and is then snapped up by another party.
